title: My Rich Twin Sister Is EVIL

characters.name: Ivy
characters.look: Long wavy chestnut-brown hair in a low messy ponytail with a small yellow star clip, green eyes, no makeup, faded oversized grey hoodie, patched blue jeans, worn white sneakers. Same face as Celeste.

characters.name: Celeste
characters.look: Identical face to Ivy: long chestnut-brown hair in sleek glossy curls with a gold headband, green eyes, winged eyeliner and red lipstick, white silk blouse, black pleated skirt, pearl necklace, black heeled boots.

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: Messy black hair, warm brown eyes, navy school blazer worn open with a loose red tie, white shirt, black trousers, headphones around his neck.

characters.name: Grandma Rosa
characters.look: Grey hair in a neat bun, round gold glasses, warm brown eyes, maroon knitted cardigan over a floral dress, white diner apron.

characters.name: Victoria
characters.look: Platinum-blonde elegant updo, blue eyes, emerald-green satin gown, diamond drop earrings, white gloves.

characters.name: Richard
characters.look: Slicked-back dark hair with grey at the temples, short beard, grey eyes, navy three-piece suit, gold tie and gold watch.

locations.name: diner
locations.description: A small cosy 1950s-style diner at evening: red vinyl booths, checkered black-and-white floor, a counter with chrome stools, warm yellow lights and rain on the windows.

locations.name: school hallway
locations.description: A grand private-academy hallway in bright morning light: polished marble floor, tall arched windows, dark wooden lockers with gold trim, a crest banner reading Ashford Academy.

locations.name: mansion living room
locations.description: A huge luxurious living room in afternoon light: white marble floor, a crystal chandelier, a small indoor fountain, cream sofas, gold-framed paintings and a grand staircase behind.

locations.name: celeste bedroom night
locations.description: A lavish pink and gold bedroom at night: canopy bed, vanity mirror ringed with bulbs, designer bags on shelves, dark window with city lights, moody purple lamp glow.

locations.name: small apartment
locations.description: A tiny but warm apartment kitchen-living room in the evening: peeling pastel wallpaper, an old sofa with a crocheted blanket, family photos on the fridge, a single warm lamp.

locations.name: school cafeteria
locations.description: A fancy school cafeteria at lunchtime: long white tables, big windows with sunshine, a salad bar, potted plants and students' trays.

locations.name: ballroom
locations.description: A glittering mansion ballroom at night for a charity gala: gold chandeliers, marble pillars, round tables with white cloths and candles, a string quartet stage, deep red curtains.

locations.name: mansion garden night
locations.description: A mansion garden at night: trimmed hedges, a stone fountain, fairy lights on the trees, a dark blue sky with stars, the bright mansion windows in the distance.

locations.name: school rooftop
locations.description: A school rooftop at sunset: a chain-link fence, a bench, orange and pink sky over the city skyline, a few potted plants.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Seventeen years ago, two baby girls were born on the same stormy night.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One went home with a millionaire family. The other... didn't go home at all.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Grandma! Table six left a five dollar tip!

lines.speaker: Grandma Rosa
lines.text: Look at you, mija. Saving every penny.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Every penny for college. That's the plan.

lines.speaker: Grandma Rosa
lines.text: I wish I could give you more, Ivy.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: You gave me everything. You took me in when nobody else would.

lines.speaker: Grandma Rosa
lines.text: Speaking of... a letter came for you today.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Wait. That's the Ashford Academy logo!

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: *opens letter* I got the full scholarship?!

lines.speaker: Grandma Rosa
lines.text: My girl is going to the richest school in the city!

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Rich kids can't be that bad, right?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She was about to find out.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: This hallway is bigger than our whole apartment...

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: First day? You look lost.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Is it that obvious?

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I'm Leo. Scholarship kid too. We have to stick together.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: I'm Ivy. Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Excuse me, you're blocking my locker, you-

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: ...What.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: You... you have my face!

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: No. YOU have MY face.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: There are TWO of you?!

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: *stares* Where did you get those eyes? That nose?

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: I don't know. I never met my parents. My grandma took me in.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Interesting. Very interesting.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Let's be friends, Ivy! Come to my house after school.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Really? Okay!

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: (whispers) Be careful. Celeste Ashford doesn't make friends. She makes victims.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: You LIVE here? There's a fountain. Inside.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Three fountains, actually. Mother! Father! Come see!

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Celeste? And... another Celeste?!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Good heavens. Am I seeing double?

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: This is Ivy. We met at school. Isn't it funny?

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Richard... the hospital. Seventeen years ago.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Victoria, not now.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: What hospital? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: When we adopted Celeste, the nurse said there was another baby. A sister.

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: But the papers were lost. We searched for months. We never found her.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: So she's my twin sister? I have a real family?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: It seems you do, young lady.

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Oh, sweetheart. Come here!

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: *smiles* Welcome to the family... sister.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Seventeen years. Seventeen years I was the ONLY one.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Mother looked at her like she was some lost treasure.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: And Father's will leaves everything to 'our daughter.'

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Not daughters. Daughter. Singular.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: So one of us has to go. And it won't be me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celeste had a plan. And it started with a diamond necklace.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Grandma, they want me to visit every weekend!

lines.speaker: Grandma Rosa
lines.text: Rich people, mija... they don't always give without taking.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Celeste is so nice to me, though. She's even lending me her clothes.

lines.speaker: Grandma Rosa
lines.text: Hmm. A girl who has everything, suddenly sharing?

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: You sound like Leo.

lines.speaker: Grandma Rosa
lines.text: Then Leo is a smart boy. Promise me you'll keep your eyes open.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: I promise. Love you, Grandma.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Ivy! I saved you a seat. And I brought you a gift!

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: A designer bag? Celeste, I can't take this!

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Nonsense. Sisters share everything.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: (quietly) Since when does she share anything?

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Did you say something, scholarship boy?

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Nope. Just eating my sandwich.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Bring the bag to the gala on Saturday. Mother will love it.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Ivy, I've known her three years. She's never been nice for free.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Maybe she's changed. Maybe she was lonely too.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Or maybe that bag isn't a gift. Can I see it for a second?

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Fine. But you're being paranoid.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Saturday night. The Ashford charity gala.

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Ivy, you look beautiful!

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Thank you, Mrs. Ashford.

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Wait... my necklace. My grandmother's diamond necklace is gone!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Security! Lock the doors!

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Mother, who would do such a thing?

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: *looks at Ivy's bag* Ivy... why is your bag sparkling?

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: What? No, I didn't-

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Open the bag. Now.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: *opens bag* The necklace? How is it in here?!

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: We opened our home to you. And you steal from us?

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: I swear I didn't take it! Celeste gave me this bag!

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: How could you blame me? I trusted you!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Get out of my house. And never come back.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: (whispers) Bye-bye, sister.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: I finally found my family... and they think I'm a thief.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Ivy. I'm so sorry. I came as soon as you texted.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: It was her, Leo. It was Celeste all along.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I know. And I think I can prove it.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Remember when I looked at the bag in the cafeteria?

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I slipped my old phone into the side pocket. Recording.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Leo! That's... genius!

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Listen to this part.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 'Plant the necklace, cry a little, and she's gone forever.'

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: That's Celeste's voice. She planned the whole thing.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Then it's time the Ashfords heard it too.

lines.speaker: Grandma Rosa
lines.text: They called my granddaughter a THIEF?!

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: It's okay, Grandma. We have proof.

lines.speaker: Grandma Rosa
lines.text: Then get your coat. Let's go ruin a rich girl's day.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I told you never to come back.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Give me five minutes. Then I'll leave forever.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Let her talk, Father. It's sad, really.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: *presses play*

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 'Plant the necklace, cry a little, and she's gone forever. Father's money stays mine.'

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: That's... Celeste's voice.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Celeste. Explain. Now.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: It's fake! She made it with AI!

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: There's more. Keep listening.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 'And if Mother asks, I'll just cry. She always believes the tears.'

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Always believes the tears?!

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: FINE! Yes, I did it! She was going to take everything!

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: You looked at her like she was perfect. Like I was never enough!

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Celeste... we loved you. We still do. But what you did was cruel.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: You're going to Saint Agnes Boarding School. Effective tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: The one with no phones?! NO!

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Ivy, can you ever forgive us?

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: You believed her without even asking me.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: But I'd like to try. As long as Grandma Rosa stays in my life.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Of course. She raised you into an honest young woman.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: So. Ashford heiress now, huh?

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: I still work Saturdays at the diner. Grandma insists.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Can I visit you there? Maybe... as a date?

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Only if you leave a good tip.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Deal!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: That night, while Celeste packed for boarding school...

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: They think this is over.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: *finds an old hospital file* Wait. What's this?

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: 'Birth record: baby girl A, baby girl B... and baby girl C?'

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Twins? No. TRIPLETS.

lines.speaker: Celeste
lines.text: Hello, sister number three. Let's make a deal.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: To be continued...
